integrity: The Armijo inequality is reduced exactly to a scalar Rayleigh-quotient constraint; the gradient ratio is then maximized by a sharp spectral second-moment inequality. Endpoint spectral support gives an explicit two-dimensional equality family, and positive scaling realizes the sharp endpoint at any prescribed first backtracking trial length without changing the condition number.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-step theorem for ordinary steepest descent on real SPD quadratics under monotone Armijo sufficient decrease alone. It does not classify Wolfe-type curvature conditions, nonquadratic objectives, preconditioned directions, non-Euclidean gradient norms, finite precision, or multi-step path maxima.
title: Sharp gradient-norm safety frontier inside Armijo sufficient decrease
